scenarios.name: error_uppercase_method
scenarios.description: Rejects a challenge whose method token is not lowercase. Agreed outcome: reject (method is a lowercase registered token per spec; it is NOT case-folded to a single normalization). Discriminating: an SDK that case-folds or accepts "TEMPO" verbatim diverges and fails RED. (TS reference already rejects.)
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_upper", realm="api.example.com", method="TEMPO", intent="charge", request="e30"

scenarios.name: error_nonalpha_method
scenarios.description: Rejects a challenge whose method token contains a non-alphanumeric character. Agreed outcome: reject (method must match the lowercase token grammar). Discriminating: an SDK with a permissive method grammar accepts "tempo!" and fails RED. (TS reference already rejects.)
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_nonalpha", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo!", intent="charge", request="e30"

scenarios.name: error_empty_realm
scenarios.description: Rejects a challenge with an empty-but-PRESENT realm (realm="", key present, value empty — distinct from the key-absent error_missing_realm). Agreed outcome: reject (a required field present with an empty value is invalid, mirroring error_empty_id). RED-EXPECTED for the TS reference until the empty-value guard in @solana/mpp (src/shared/challenge-guard.ts) is extended from id to realm/intent; the WWW-Auth fix in this worktree closes it.
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_empty_realm", realm="", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30"
